headline: Linus Torvalds says AI-written fixes now outpace bug reports in Linux kernel
summary: Linux creator Linus Torvalds said AI-generated fixes drove most of the progress in the latest kernel release, with AI-written patches for BPF outnumbering new bug reports, a sign the flood of AI-prompted patches may have peaked.

claims.statement: AI-written fixes now outnumber new bug reports for at least one part (BPF) of the Linux kernel.

sources.quote: BPF saw more AI-written fixes than bug reports, possibly indicating a tidal shift
Fixes are arriving faster than new bug reports for one major Linux project

claims.statement: Linus Torvalds commented on the growing role of AI-written fixes in kernel development.
